title_en: Build AnalyticsAdapter composing a legacy two-call API
spec_html_en: Legacy LegacyAnalytics requires two separate calls: start_session(session_id) then log_event(session_id, event). Write class AnalyticsAdapter composing a LegacyAnalytics instance and a session_id. Its single method track(self, event) must adapt the new one-call interface to the legacy one: on the very first call it must call start_session before logging, and on every call it must call log_event. The session must be started at most once, even across multiple track calls.
test:
def test_first_track_starts_session_then_logs():
    legacy = LegacyAnalytics()
    adapter = AnalyticsAdapter(legacy, 'sess-1')
    adapter.track('click')
    assert legacy.calls == [('start', 'sess-1'), ('event', 'sess-1', 'click')], 'the first track() must start the session before logging the event'

def test_second_track_does_not_start_again():
    legacy = LegacyAnalytics()
    adapter = AnalyticsAdapter(legacy, 'sess-1')
    adapter.track('click')
    adapter.track('scroll')
    assert legacy.calls == [
        ('start', 'sess-1'),
        ('event', 'sess-1', 'click'),
        ('event', 'sess-1', 'scroll'),
    ], 'a second track() must only log the event, not start the session again'

def test_multiple_adapters_track_independent_sessions():
    legacy = LegacyAnalytics()
    a = AnalyticsAdapter(legacy, 'sess-a')
    b = AnalyticsAdapter(legacy, 'sess-b')
    a.track('open')
    b.track('open')
    assert legacy.calls == [
        ('start', 'sess-a'),
        ('event', 'sess-a', 'open'),
        ('start', 'sess-b'),
        ('event', 'sess-b', 'open'),
    ], 'each adapter must manage its own started flag independently'
